name: MCMC Densification
definition: A Bayesian densification strategy that reformulates Gaussian Splatting densification as a Stochastic Gradient Langevin Dynamic (SGLD) update rule, adding noise to center locations.
summary: MCMC Densification is a Bayesian optimization strategy that updates Gaussian Splatting via Stochastic Gradient Langevin Dynamics, using noise for exploration and random re-spawning to improve rendering quality.
